values.meaning: Cooldown refund for catching returning boomerang (Mini Q)
Cooldown refund for picking up boulder (Mega Q)

mechanics.claim: Each enemy can be hit at most once per pass of the boomerang (once on the way out, once on the return).
mechanics.quote: Enemies can be hit only once per pass.

mechanics.claim: The boomerang deals only 50% damage to targets hit on its return flight, compared to the initial pass.
If Mini Gnar catches the returning boomerang, it refunds 40% of the ability's total (unreduced) cooldown, effectively lowering the achievable cooldown in a dummy fight.
mechanics.quote: Catching the boomerang while it is returning back refunds 40% of the ability's {{sti|'''total''' cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: As Mega Gnar, picking up the thrown boulder refunds 70% of the ability's total cooldown.
mechanics.quote: '''Gnar''' can pick up the boulder by moving within 90 units of it, refunding 70% of the ability's {{sti|cooldown|'''total''' cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: As Mega Gnar, the boulder stops on the first enemy hit and deals its damage in an area to nearby enemies rather than as a single-target hit.
mechanics.quote: throws a boulder in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact

mechanics.claim: The Mega Q boulder remains on the ground for 6 seconds after landing before it can be picked up (not a value that changes damage/survival directly, but affects whether the cooldown refund is achievable within the fight window).
mechanics.quote: The boulder then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.
